subject: Air freight quotes for CAI and TLV
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote the fastest air freight option for each of the two shipments below? Both will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-25 at our site in 60413 Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the airport.

1. CAI (Cairo, EG): sports equipment, 6 pieces, 553 kg gross weight, 3.41 cbm.
2. TLV (Tel Aviv, IL): spare parts for packaging machines, 1 piece, 951 kg gross weight, 4.67 cbm.

Could you send both quotes in the same reply, with a separate all-in price in EUR for each shipment rather than a combined total?

Thanks for your help!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting quotes for two new air freight shipments.
